name: Dressing the Part
objectiveText: Completion Yarrr... if ye be keen on enjoying the company of us experienced sea dogs, you'd best belay dressing like a blaggard!  Here, put on something proper 'fore I keelhaul yer hide. These'll fit ye better than they ever fit that old dog, Red-Eyed Ben.  Lost him in a devil of a storm at sea. Wear 'em with pride, mate!
